spans.s:
प्रत्न प्रत्न, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. प्र), former,
preceding, anterior; old, primeval, ancient; hitherto
prevalent, traditional, customary; (अम्), n. a kind
of metre.
—प्रत्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing
the word प्रत्न; (वत्), ind. as formerly, in the
usual manner.

प्रत्न-था, ind., Ved. as formerly, as of old, in
the usual manner.
